about.bio1: Cadastral and Geodesic Engineer with a Software Engineering specialization. Experienced in land acquisition, GIS database design, spatial analysis, and cartographic production for large-scale infrastructure and rail corridor projects across Colombia.
about.bio2: Passionate about combining geospatial technology with modern web stacks to deliver interactive maps, geospatial APIs, and decision-support systems.
about.gispDesc: GIS Certification Institute — pursuing the Certified GIS Professional credential, covering geospatial data fundamentals, GIS analysis, cartography, and programming.
